description: Employee self-service only: own leave, expenses, timesheets and procurement requests, plus the Templates member role. Own-record scope must be enforced by ASAA.
HR operations: employee records, documents, exits, onboarding and leave policy.
Finance: receivables, suppliers, budgets, expense reimbursement and procurement review.
Line managers: approvals for their teams.
ASAA administrators: every human ASAA permission. Does not include the application owner roles.
